whenToUse: Inputs where sending is frequent, such as chat or comments.
You want to give an immediate sense of having sent.
The sent result appears on the same screen.
whenNotToUse: Sending is likely to fail but it would look like success.
People leave the screen after sending, as with email.
A long flight that blocks the next input.

alternatives.name: Success Checkmark
alternatives.reason: Announcing that sending is done in a big way.

accessibility: The send button has only an icon, so it gets a name with aria-label.
When the input is empty, the button is disabled.
Sent messages are added to the conversation list (ol), so screen readers can check them.
With reduced motion, the plane and bubble movements are skipped.
